behavior: Increase bounce range by flat 3% of total range; for each bounce of a projectile, add listed percent damage.
notes: Bounce shot range increased by 3% of total tower range.

behavior: When a super crit event occurs, create a counter of guaranteed future super crit attacks equal to listed value.
notes: Next x attacks are guaranteed super crits after a super crit occurs.

behavior: At enemy spawn roll listed chance; if marked, first subsequent hit destroys that enemy regardless of ordinary damage pipeline.
notes: Marked enemy is destroyed by first hit.

behavior: Whenever Rend Armor is applied/updated, roll listed chance to set rend state immediately to max instead of normal progression.
notes: Proc sends Rend Armor directly to max.

behavior: Each attack has fixed 1% chance to apply a non-stacking mass reduction equal to listed percent.
notes: 1% fixed chance per attack; effect is explicitly non-stacking.

behavior: Killing a boss or elite grants 5x tower damage for listed seconds; a new valid kill refreshes timer rather than stacking multiplier.
notes: Wiki note: does Impact UW damage; new boss/elite kill refreshes duration.

behavior: When shockwave registers a hit, apply listed damage-taken multiplier to that enemy for 7s even if the enemy is immune to the shockwave movement/effect.
notes: Enemies still count as hit even if immune to shockwave effects.

behavior: If an orb hits and does not kill, add listed reduction to both enemy damage and speed, stacking additively until total reduction reaches 50%.
notes: Orb hit still counts for effect logic even if enemy is immune to orb effect; only if orb does not kill.

behavior: Extend regen heal ceiling beyond ordinary max HP up to listed percent of Package Max Recovery.
notes: Allows Health Regen to heal into Package Max Recovery up to listed percent.

behavior: Each landmine spawn rolls listed chance to become an autonomous Inner Land Mine subject to 20 max; damage/stat source depends on whether ILM UW is unlocked.
notes: If ILM UW unlocked, uses player ILM stats/effects; otherwise uses level-1 x30 damage multiplier. Chance applies to normal landmine spawns.

behavior: Multiply wall HP and wall regen by listed factor, and for repeated wall-thorns hits on same enemy add +1% wall-thorns damage taken per subsequent hit.
notes: Wall health and regen multiplied by listed x; enemies take +1% increased damage from wall thorns per subsequent hit.

behavior: Spawn listed number of Electrons. On Electron hit, deal 15% of current remaining HP, multiplied by 0.25 against Bosses and Fleets.
notes: Each Electron deals 15% of enemy remaining health; quarter effective against Bosses and Fleets.

behavior: Increase each bot range by listed meters and apply 2x damage-taken state to enemies hit by Flame Bot.
notes: All bots gain listed meters of range; enemies hit by Flame Bot receive double damage.

behavior: When a recovery package is collected, reduce cooldown of all eligible Ultimate Weapons (UWs) except Poison Swamp by listed seconds.
notes: Wiki explicitly excludes Poison Swamp.

behavior: Each projectile hit rolls listed proc chance; on proc, reduce both enemy Health level and Attack level by 1, with diminishing returns after 100 total reductions on that enemy.
notes: Each proc reduces both Health and Attack level by 1.

behavior: For each free-upgrade trigger during current wave, add listed percent to temporary coin/kill bonus for that wave, excluding Tower Range increases as valid triggers.
notes: Bonus applies when free upgrade triggers even if no upgrades remain in that category; free upgrades cannot increase Tower Range.

behavior: Compute tower damage multiplier from current cash digit count / logarithmic form; clamp final multiplier to at least x1.00.
notes: Wiki note gives effective form (1 + Log(cash) * rarityMult); multiplier never below x1.00.

behavior: On package pickup, apply 50% attack speed boost for listed seconds and then decay over 60 seconds; new package refreshes timer.
notes: New package refreshes effect rather than stacking duration.

behavior: Retarget Spotlight to the boss and cause reflected light around that boss to increase nearby enemies damage taken by listed multiplier.
notes: Spotlight rotates to focus a boss.

behavior: When a poisoned enemy attempts an attack, roll listed miss chance; halve that chance for bosses.
notes: Boss chance is halved.

behavior: Allow CL to hit initial target with 60% chance, double shock chance and base shock multiplier, and when shock reapplies to same enemy additively accumulate multiplier up to listed stack count.
notes: CL has 60% chance to hit initial target; shock chance and multiplier doubled. Wiki note: base shock mult with max lab 1.66x becomes 2.32x after doubling; total stack form 1 + 1.32*n.

behavior: Compute shared cooldown from average of DW, GT, BH base cooldowns adjusted by listed offset, then schedule all three to fire simultaneously on that unified cooldown.
notes: Wiki says Death Wave, Golden Tower, and Black Hole always activate at same time; cooldown is average of three plus/minus listed seconds. At Ancestral the offset is -10s.

behavior: When boss enters tower range, fire listed number of ILM at it; when elite enters range, do same on a fixed 25% trigger.
notes: Fires ILM at bosses as they enter tower range; 25% of elites also get targeted.

behavior: Spawn one extra Black Hole and, while enemies are inside any Black Hole, reduce their outgoing damage by listed percent.
notes: Spawns one additional Black Hole.
